verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a community comment that AOT compilation and tree-shaking are Angular capabilities and that components avoid 'dependency hell'. First-party docs only make generic 'fast' claims and describe a first-party module platform (forms, routing), which loosely implies fewer third-party dependencies. missing for 10: first-party documentation of bundle-size optimization (tree-shaking, AOT, budgets), measured bundle-size or runtime-footprint data, explicit evidence on dependency count or supply-chain risk reduction, and independent hands-on corroboration.
